title: %escapeXml - escape XML special characters
purpose: Escape & < > " and the apostrophe as XML entities, using ' for the apostrophe.
input:
raw = "x = 'a' & b"
tag = "<a href=\"u\">"
plain = "no specials"
expectedOutput:
{out}
escaped = "x = 'a' & b"
angles = "<a href="u">"
plain = "no specials"
notes: Differs from %escapeHtml only in the apostrophe, which becomes ' (valid XML).
